info.title: Patra AI Cards API
info.description: API for model cards and datasheets with JWT-aware privacy

get.description: List all model cards. JWT bearer shows private; unauthenticated shows only public.

schema.title: Response List Model Cards Modelcards Get

get.description: Get a single model card by UUID. Returns 404 if private and caller has no JWT.

put.description: Update a model card and its linked AI model (authenticated users only).

schema.title: Response Get Model Deployments Modelcard  Uuid  Deployments Get

get.description:
List all datasheets. JWT bearer shows private; unauthenticated shows only public.

Summary view flattens the first title, creator, and subject (category) per datasheet.
Get a single datasheet by UUID. Returns 404 if private and caller has no JWT.

delete.description: Delete a datasheet (admin only). Child rows cascade; linked model_cards.training_datasheet_id is set NULL.

schema.title: Response List Editable Records V1 Assets Records Get

Response Get Experiment Images Experiments  Domain   Experiment Id  Images Get
Response Get Experiment Power Experiments  Domain   Experiment Id  Power Get

post.description:
Fetch a public Hugging Face model/dataset repo and return flat fields
matching the Submit form's reactive state. Never persists anything —
the caller is expected to review/edit before creating the record.

get.description: Liveness probe: confirms the process is up.
Readiness probe: confirms the API can still talk to PostgreSQL.

HFImportFields.title: HFImportFields
HFImportFields.description:
Union of mcForm + dsForm keys we can realistically fill from Hugging Face.

Only one "half" of these will ever be populated for a given request
(model_card fields vs. datasheet fields); `license` is shared by both
forms and has the same meaning in either case.
